description: Lets a business send its booking confirmations, reminders and payment requests from its own domain through Slyde (slydeonline.com). Adds a DKIM key and an SPF/bounce pair on dedicated subdomains; the domain's existing mail records (MX and SPF at the root) are not touched.
variableDescription: dkim: the DKIM public key Slyde issued for this domain. mx: the bounce-handling mail server for the send subdomain (varies by sending region).
